rules.law_name: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting
rules.title: Bill to prohibit algorithmic rent setting
rules.requirement: This bill would prohibit algorithmic rent setting in rental housing. The document is a bill history page and does not state the operative details of the prohibition.

coverage.summary: The document does not state which rental housing, landlords, or tenancies would be covered.
